name: What is the lifespan of a commercial water heater?

mainEntity.name: What is the lifespan of a commercial water heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical lifespan of a commercial water heater ranges from 8 to 15 years, though this can vary based on the unit's type, maintenance schedule, and the intensity of its usage. High-demand businesses or those with inconsistent maintenance may experience a shorter lifespan. Regular professional servicing, offered by CG Plumbing Solutions, can help maximize the longevity and efficiency of your unit.
acceptedAnswer.description: A commercial water heater generally lasts 8-15 years, depending on type, maintenance, and usage. Regular servicing can extend its lifespan.
